issues.description: New slash command labels are hardcoded Chinese strings instead of using i18n t() function. Existing entries use t.editorCmdXxx but new ones have raw strings.
issues.recommendation: Add i18n keys for table/math/math-block/callout labels and descriptions in a follow-up

issues.description: Scope label '导出范围' is a hardcoded Chinese string, not i18n'd

MathBlock has both 'atom: true' and 'content: text*' — these are somewhat contradictory. Atom nodes typically have no editable content. The content spec works because the ReactNodeViewRenderer overrides the DOM, but the TipTap schema declares text* which won't be used.
issues.recommendation: Consider removing 'content: text*' for clarity, or document the intentional override

issues.description: Callout markdown export uses GitHub-style > [!VARIANT] syntax but doesn't prefix inner content lines with > on the first line after the marker when inner is single-line
issues.recommendation: Edge case only — multi-line callouts work correctly

issues.description: isEditing defaults to true — every new math node starts in edit mode. This is intentional (user just inserted it) but means no rendered output until first interaction
issues.recommendation: Consider starting in render mode if latex attr is pre-populated (e.g. from paste/import)

positive_observations: Clean extension architecture: MathInline/MathBlock share MathView component via ReactNodeViewRenderer
KaTeX loaded via dynamic import() — no bundle bloat for non-math users
exportDocx.ts nodeHandlers pattern is extensible and well-structured
Callout uses standard TipTap command pattern with TypeScript module augmentation
ExportDialog scope selector correctly disables for PDF and when no projectId
HTML export properly escapes LaTeX in data attributes
Markdown callout uses GitHub-compatible syntax for interoperability
summary: Phase 2 implementation is solid. Architecture is clean and follows established patterns. 1 medium issue (i18n for new slash commands), 4 low-severity observations. No blockers.
